subject: Learning Methods
title: Environment Design for Habits
description: A quick win: understand Environment Design for Habits.

hook.text: People who kept fruit on the counter ate 70 % more fruit than those who stored it in the fridge.

buildup.text: Environment design changes the cues around you. Make desired behaviors easy and visible, undesired ones hard.

discovery.text: For learning, this means: keep books on your desk, not on a shelf. Keep your study app on the home screen, not in.

twist.text: Willpower is unreliable. People who appear disciplined have designed environments that reduce the need for willpower.

climax.text: Redesign your study space tonight. Put materials in plain sight. Remove distractions.

punchline.text: Design the space. The environment decides your behavior.

quiz.question: Why is environment design more effective than willpower?
options: Visible cues trigger habits automatically, reducing the need for willpower
Willpower only works for physical tasks, not learning
